_note: WHETHER A MODEL LOADS IS NOT A PROPERTY OF THE MODEL. It is a property of (model x environment), and this file keys it that way because the v3 grid proved the point twice in one night: LLM360/AmberSafe failed and then succeeded on the SAME BOX after two packages were installed, and thirteen checkpoints that load without complaint on this Mac are unloadable on an A100 because of a torch version floor. A registry field like `needs_torch` is a summary of these observations, not a substitute for them -- so the observations live here and the summary is derived.

observations.cause: **LOADS AND RUNS, AND SILENTLY DESTROYS THE PROMPT.** backend pre_tokenizer is Metaspace where the checkpoint's own tokenizer.json declares ByteLevel+Split, so encode('a b') == encode('ab'): every space is deleted before the model sees anything, and CJK decodes to the EMPTY STRING. transformers 5.4.0 / tokenizers 0.22.2.
observations.fix: NONE KNOWN in this environment. Caught only by a round-trip assertion decode(encode(p)) == p; no load guard, finiteness check or cell count can see it.

observations.cause: As the base sibling: encode('a b') == encode('ab').
observations.fix: None known.

observations.cause: Loads; DELETES CJK CHARACTERS. 他既是美丽的又是恶心的，她想要 -> 他是美的是心的想要, dropping 既 丽 又 恶 ， 她 -- including BOTH halves of the 既...又 both-and construction. English is exact.
observations.fix: Usable for Latin-script prompts only. Caught by round-trip.

observations.cause: Loads; normalises the FULLWIDTH COMMA to ASCII. Drops only ，. Milder than Croissant and a different kind of loss.
observations.fix: Latin-script prompts exact; CJK prompts altered. Round-trip catches it.

observations.cause: Round-trip LOOKS broken and is not: decode returns a leading space from SentencePiece's leading marker. encode(p) != encode(' '+p), so the encode is faithful and the space never reaches the model. Its CJK handling IS lossy (fullwidth comma).
observations.fix: Allow the leading space ONLY where encode proves it can represent the distinction.

observations.cause: Round-trip LOOKS broken and is not: prepends [gMASK]<sop> and bos_token_id is None, so a BOS-only strip cannot see them. skip_special_tokens recovers the prompt exactly.
observations.fix: Allow a special-token prefix, gated on the tokenizer still distinguishing the text from its space-stripped form.

observations.cause: Runs, but on the NAIVE sequential scan: transformers' FalconMamba integration does not use mamba-ssm/causal-conv1d and emits 'the fast path is not available ... pip install kernels'. The four Falcon-H1 checkpoints on the same box emit NO such warning, so the kernels are in use for the hybrid and not for the pure SSM.
observations.fix: NONE NEEDED. The kernels are a measured null for pure SSM (0.62-0.64 with vs 0.61-0.72 without); timed 0.7-1.7 min/model here. Installing `kernels` would change the numerical path away from every pure-SSM cell already in the corpus for no gain.

provisioning_lessons: INSTALL requirements.txt ON THE BOX. sentencepiece and protobuf were declared in the repo and absent from the instance; that alone cost one model and an hour.
PIN torch >= 2.6, or thirteen checkpoints in the 103-model spec are unloadable and the cause reads like a transformers policy.
DO NOT install tiktoken to silence a SentencePiece conversion error. It lets the wrong converter succeed on a SentencePiece file, turning a loud failure into a quiet one.

Library versions are an INSTRUMENT dimension. Local vs box on one shared model: identical surface set, per-word probabilities differing by <=1.5e-3. Small, not zero -- cells now stamp torch_version and transformers_version.
The box ran 5.14.1 while every precondition was established locally on 5.4.0. An encode guarantee established on a different library version than the run uses is not a guarantee.

RUN ARCHIVES DO NOT BELONG IN meta/. meta/ is one folder per meta-finding, with clause tables and scope sentences; a run log is not a claim. Putting the grid_v3 archive there routed around `logs/` being gitignored -- and that gitignore rule was the thing that would have stopped a live HF_TOKEN from entering a commit. GitHub push protection caught it instead. The archive now lives at logs/cloud_runs/grid_v3_46301965/, local and untracked; the facts worth keeping were already in THIS file.

PROVISIONING WRITES CREDENTIALS INTO SCRIPTS, AND ARCHIVING THOSE SCRIPTS PUBLISHES THEM. launch.sh/repair.sh/repair2.sh each carried an inline HF_TOKEN because the gated Llama checkpoints need it and the box had no profile to source. Scan the whole tree before committing a pulled run directory, not just the files a scanner happens to name.
